body.body:
## OpenAI 账号管理系统 v2

### 下载说明
| 平台 | 文件 |
|------|------|
| Windows x64 | `codex-register-v2-windows-x64.exe` |
| Linux x64 | `codex-register-v2-linux-x64` |
| macOS ARM64 | `codex-register-v2-macos-arm64` |

### 使用方法
```bash
# Linux/macOS 需要先赋予执行权限
chmod +x codex-register-*

# 启动 Web UI
./codex-register

# 指定端口
./codex-register --port 8080

# 调试模式（热重载）
./codex-register --debug

# 设置 Web UI 访问密钥
./codex-register --access-password mypassword
```


## What's Changed
* feat: 支持 cloud-mail 自部署邮箱服务 by @ZHOUKAILIAN in https://github.com/cnlimiter/codex-manager/pull/105
* fix: validate NEWAPI token input across UI and API by @MisonL in https://github.com/cnlimiter/codex-manager/pull/109
* fix: 修复导入邮箱和现有账号场景下重复命中旧验证码的问题 by @ZHOUKAILIAN in https://github.com/cnlimiter/codex-manager/pull/106
* fixbug: 在 f-string 中统一使用单引号替代双引号，避免嵌套引号问题 by @hhhaiai in https://github.com/cnlimiter/codex-manager/pull/111

## New Contributors
* @hhhaiai made their first contribution in https://github.com/cnlimiter/codex-manager/pull/111

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cnlimiter/codex-manager/compare/v1.1.2...v1.1.3
